## Activity

During November 2025, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 424 captures. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 424 captures, 29 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.8 per cent. These results identify the captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered in routine monitoring of image quality. Staff raised no new equipment faults during November 2025.

## Grading

A total of 112 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days, representing the midpoint of the reported time between capture and completion of grading. The grading results should be considered alongside the ungradable findings when reviewing overall site performance. Together, the measures provide a summary of capture activity, image quality and grading outcomes at Harbour Eye Clinic for November 2025.
